package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

var _ repository.LearningWorkspaceSnapshotReader = (*LearningJourneyRepoPG)(nil)

const learningWorkspacePathColumns = `p.id, p.student_id, p.course_id, p.goal_code, p.curriculum_revision,
p.policy_version, p.planner_policy_version, p.reason_code, p.reason_summary, p.status, p.is_primary,
p.version, p.created_at, p.updated_at`

// ReadLearningWorkspace observes the selected context, its exact ACTIVE path,
// and ordered item statuses in one repeatable-read, read-only transaction. It
// never creates receipts, changes progress, or leaks another student's path.
func (repo *LearningJourneyRepoPG) ReadLearningWorkspace(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
) (domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource, error) {
	if repo == nil || repo.Pool == nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, errors.New("learning journey repository pool is required")
	}
	tx, err := repo.Pool.BeginTx(ctx, pgx.TxOptions{IsoLevel: pgx.RepeatableRead, AccessMode: pgx.ReadOnly})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = tx.Rollback(ctx) }()

	source := domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{StudentID: studentID}
	contextValue, err := getLearningContext(ctx, tx, studentID, false)
	if errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound) {
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
		}
		return source, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
	}
	source.Context = contextValue
	if contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID == "" {
		if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
			return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
		}
		return source, nil
	}

	path, err := scanLearningPath(tx.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT `+learningWorkspacePathColumns+`
FROM student_learning_context c
JOIN student_learning_path p ON p.id=c.selected_learning_path_id
  AND p.student_id=c.student_id
  AND p.status='ACTIVE'
WHERE c.student_id=$1 AND c.selected_learning_path_id=$2 AND c.selected_path_status='ACTIVE'`, studentID, contextValue.SelectedLearningPathID))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
	}
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
	}
	if err := loadLearningPathItems(ctx, tx, &path); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
	}
	path, err = domain.NormalizeStudentLearningPath(path)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, domain.ErrStateChanged
	}
	source.SelectedPath = &path
	if err := tx.Commit(ctx); err != nil {
		return domain.StudentLearningWorkspaceSource{}, err
	}
	return source, nil
}
